title: Charmed baryon decays at Belle and Belle II
summary: Belle and Belle II experiments have collected $e^+e^-$ collision data with center-of-mass energies at or near the $Υ(4S)$ resonance. Using total $1.4\,\mathrm{ab}^{-1}$ combined dataset, we present new measurements of branching fractions for $Ξ_c^{0/+}$ and $Λ_c^+$ baryons, including several first observations. Additionally, we report the initial search for $CP$ violation in singly Cabibbo-suppressed three-body decays of charmed baryons, providing a test of $U$-spin symmetry.
